input.\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cul\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Ci\u003EThis E-log also reflects my patient's centered online learning portfolio.\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; I have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; of \"Patient Clinical Data Analysis\" to develop my competency in reading\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings,\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; investigations and come up with a diagnosis and providing treatment\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; best to our skills and wisdom.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; The patient\/ attender was informed the purpose of the information being\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; acquired. An informed consent was taken from patient\/ attender and\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; there is omission of information that was requested to be omitted.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: red;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: red; font-size: medium;\"\u003EA 48 years old male , bus driver by occupation presented to opd with chief\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: red; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;complains of huge\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: red; font-size: medium;\"\u003Eabdominal distension\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: red; font-size: large;\"\u003E.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: red; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: red; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E➤Abdomen distension since 4months\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E➤Swelling\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;of both legs since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E➤Decreased\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;urine since 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDAILY ROUTINE\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe used to get up by 5 and by 5:30 after getting freshed up he makes green tea for himself as he doesn't want to disturb his wife. After taking tea with couple of biscuits and a beetel nut, he goes to bus stand where he was working as a bus driver. Interestingly he starts from his home by 6 and covers 5km within 15mins.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBy 6:30 he starts from siliguri for tinsukia which is around 1000kms.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAt 9o clock he haunts his bus for breakfast where he takes rice dal with two pieces of fish and starts again.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis next stop was at 1 pm when he takes rice daal few pieces of small fish. And this time Instead of driving he takes rest and his assistant drives till 5pm.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWhere bus stops and he takes a cup of milk with a packet of biscuit and beetel nut and starts his journey on driving seat.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe takes next hault at 10pm where he stops for dinner and again takes rice dal and fish and drives whole night and stops next day at 6am. He gets freshed up takes a cup of tea with biscuits and few betel nuts. And after taking rice daily fish in breakfast he finally reaches tinsukia In afternoon. After taking proper sound sleep till evening , he goes to a hotel where he takes 600ml of Desi beer with fishes. And sleeps by 10pm. He gets up by 5 next day and drove bus back to siliguri.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe takes this round trip two times in a week.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe used to smoke bidi and guthka amid his journey but never took alcohol cause of strict police screening.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe is into this profession since 28 years and took last trip 3 days before coming here so probably his last alcohol intake was then. Although he denied taking alcohol since few months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 4months ago. Following his daily routine he was cycling to earn his bread at around 6am. Few of his friends noticed that he is getting fat and obese but cause of his healthy life style he didn't pay much heed. Within 2-3 weeks few more people noticed that he is getting protruded abdomen which doesn't seems to fit in the puzzle according to his general physique. Some said that he has jaundice and sent him to a quack who seems to cure jaundice Within couple of hours. Although his so called jaundice didn't get cure but that quack said him that he got water in his belly and need to take proper medical care. And after few investigations he presented to our hospital with chief complaints of distended abdomen which is insidious in onset gradually progressive associated with decreased appetite since then.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBilateral pedal edema extending upto knee since 2 months , pitting type increased on walking and relieved with rest\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDecreased urinary output since 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o fever, cough, breathlessness.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o drowsiness, loss of consciousness, palpitations, orthopnoea,pnd ,abdominal pain, fever,nausea vomiting.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E➤Patient takes mixed diet and has a decreased appetite .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E➤Sleep : Regular\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E➤Bowel movements are regular and PRESENTED TO GM OPD FOR ROUTINE CHECK UP"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E29\/M presented to General Medicine OPD for routine check up.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory : Patient got married in 2021 and in June 2022 he got swelling in right side of neck around cervical region. Swelling was insidious in onset and gradually progressive. On consultation he had FNAC done and diagnosed as extra pulmonary tuberculosis. Previous reports are not present as patient threw them. He was put on medication for tuberculosis from June 2022 to March 2023 that's for 9 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn September 2023 patient was planning to conceive for which he got his full body check up where his ALT, AST and ALP were raised. Due to some engagements he didn't approach medical care. Then in November 2023 he came to our hospital with same reports (attached below).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDaily Routine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5 am : he wakes up\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E6am : he signs in for work and also takes one egg with one glass of milk.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8 am : he takes breakfast sometimes idli sambhar and some times dosa sambhar.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E11am: he takes juice\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1pm : he takes lunch one plate rice, dal and tea\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E6pm : goes for workout and walk\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8pm : dinner, chapati and sometimes rice with curry.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history :
